theorem QOU.MassTheory.SegmentCollision.chain3_trace {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (hD : MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.DisjointBlockMultiplicative T) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n + 1 ≤ m) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ T.H n) (b : A) (hb : b ∈ MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.shifted T (n + 1)) (hbm : b ∈ T.H m) (c : A) (hc : c ∈ MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.shifted T (m + 1)) (α₁ β₁ γ₁ α₂ β₂ γ₂ : R) :
T.tr (a * bondLetter T n α₁ β₁ γ₁ * b * bondLetter T m α₂ β₂ γ₂ * c) = (α₁ + β₁ * T.z + γ₁ * T.zinv) * (α₂ + β₂ * T.z + γ₂ * T.zinv) * (T.tr a * T.tr b * T.tr c)

theorem QOU.MassTheory.SegmentCollision.window_cannot_separate {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (hD : MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.DisjointBlockMultiplicative T) (m : ℕ) (L L' : A) (hL : L ∈ T.H m) (hL' : L' ∈ T.H m) (N : A) (hN : N ∈ MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.shifted T m) (x : A) (hx : x ∈ MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.shifted T m) :

theorem QOU.MassTheory.SegmentCollision.bridge_local_state {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (hD : MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.DisjointBlockMultiplicative T) (n : ℕ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ T.H n) (b : A) (hb : b ∈ MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.shifted T (n + 1)) (α β γ : R) :

theorem QOU.MassTheory.SegmentCollision.bridge_crossing {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (hD : MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.DisjointBlockMultiplicative T) (n : ℕ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ T.H n) (b : A) (hb : b ∈ MathlibExt.DisjointBlockTrace.shifted T (n + 1)) :
